title: Holiday Makers Market | Day 1
seo_title: Holiday Makers Market Day 1 in Joplin, MO
description: The Holiday Makers Market is a festive market at Spiva Center for the Arts where you can find unique gifts and support local makers. More programming and a list of participating artists are still to come, and anyone interested in a booth can contact Kearstin Mattox at 417-681-9801. It takes place December 4, 2026, Time TBD, at 215 W 7th St in Joplin, MO.
